items.t: PLTR's Rule of 40 Hits 158%: Can This Momentum Continue?
items.sum: Palantir's Rule of 40 surges to 158% in Q3 2026, fueled by accelerating AI adoption, 96% revenue growth and expanding margins. Can the momentum last?

items.t: The Same $10,000 in Nvidia and Palantir Could Produce Very Different Results by 2030
items.sum: One company sells the chips behind the AI boom, the other sells the software that puts them to work. After a brutal tech selloff, a five-year model sizes up two $10,000 bets and finds one has a much wider range of outcomes.

items.t: Cathie Wood Is Buying the CoreWeave Dip and Selling Palantir
items.sum: ARK stepped into a sliding AI infrastructure stock while quietly trimming a premium-priced winner. One date next week could decide whether that bet on debt-fueled growth was savvy or early.

items.t: AI Stocks Bounce, but Leadership Rotates to AMD and Palantir as Nvidia Lags Into Earnings
items.sum: AI stocks bounce unevenly as earnings winners like AMD and PLTR lead, while NVDA lags; rotation—not broad recovery—defines the move.

items.t: Cathie Wood Buys the Dip in CoreWeave, Sells Palantir Stock: Ark Also Trades Archer Aviation, Rocket Lab, Amazon
items.sum: Cathie Wood’s Ark Invest added CoreWeave and aviation stocks while trimming Palantir, Amazon and BYD on Thursday.

items.t: Palantir (PLTR) Faces A European Rival In Defense AI
items.sum: Palantir Technologies (NasdaqGS:PLTR) faces fresh European competition as Helsing GmbH unveils its Clarity AI defense platform. Clarity is being introduced as a European controlled system designed to comply with EU sovereignty expectations and NATO interoperability standards.
